paragraphs: In [Nedarim 29b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.29b.9), Rabbi Avin and Rav Yitzchak Berabbi sat before Rabbi Yirmiyah while Rabbi Yirmiyah was dozing, etc. But without doubt the name should read Rav Yitzchak bar Yosef; see his entry.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The consulted Nedarim paragraph expressly says Rabbi Yirmiyah was dozing. The proposed bar Yosef reading is Hyman’s confident correction.

The linked Gemara calls him Rav Yitzchak Berabbi. It explicitly names Rabbi Yirmeyah as the one dozing. Hyman emphatically proposes Rav Yitzchak bar Yosef. See [Heilprin’s bar Yosef entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2164&lang=en).
